entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 11267 of 2023

Applicant :- Jamir Khan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Vaibhav Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Vaibhav Srivastava, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Anurag Verma,
the learned A.G.A-I for the State and perused the record.
2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
26 of 2023, under Section 406 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Raunahi, District Ayodhya/Faizabad.
3.

The applicant has already been granted bail in the present case under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468,
471, 504, 506 I.P.C., by means of an order dated 22.08.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc.
Bail Application No. 10456 of 2023.

sentences.text:
4. Subsequently, during investigation Section 406 I.P.C. has been added by the Investigating Officer and, therefore, the instant bail application has been filed for seeking grant of bail to the applicant in the added section.

entities.text: Jamir Khan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As the applicant has already been granted bail in the present case and merely a section has been added on the basis of some set of factual premise, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be granted bail in the added section also.
6. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

7. Let the applicant- Jamir Khan be released on bail in the aforesaid case, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned,
subject to the following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Preeti.
